title: Money and treats
intro: Money talk. No judgment. Okay, a little judgment.

cards.prompt: You find $200 in a jacket you haven't worn since last winter.

options.t: Concert tickets. Tonight if possible.
Straight into savings. Future me says thanks.
Dinner for my people. Found money gets shared.
It went to a bill. Romance is dead.

cards.mask: looks like a lucky find; measures whether spare money becomes an experience now or a cushion for later (L1, T13), with slight generosity (T06A)

friend.prompt: {name} finds $200 in an old jacket. Where does it go?

cards.prompt: Confession time. The last time you wanted one more of something you already own plenty of. Tote bags, figures, skins, mugs. What did you do?

options.t: Bought it on the spot. A new look is half the fun.
Cleared out a few old ones first, then bought it.
Left it in my cart for a week. The feeling passed.
Bought it, then hid the bag for a few days.
Money said no, so that was that.

cards.mask: looks like a shopping confession; measures whether a full collection limits a new treat (Sally Q36, T14, did-grade)

friend.prompt: {name} already owns plenty of tote bags and spots a new one to love. What happens?

cards.prompt: Housewarming tour. Your friend pats the kitchen island: 'I worked so hard for this.' Their parents covered the down payment.
cards.teenPrompt: Your friend's parents paid for a private coach all year. They made the team and say, 'I earned this spot.'

options.t: 'You earned it!' I say, and mean it.
Must be nice. Somebody had to say it.

cards.mask: looks like a hot take on a friend; measures whether you credit the effort or name the family head start (Sally Q13, T15)

friend.prompt: A friend whose parents helped a lot says 'I worked so hard for this.' What does {name} think?

cards.prompt: A plant for your room. $10 at the big store, or $25 from a neighbor whose sales fund the animal shelter.

options.t: The neighbor's. My plant has a backstory now.
The $10 one. The plant can't tell the difference.

cards.mask: looks like a price check; measures paying clearly more so a purchase helps someone versus budget first (Sally Q35 reframed, T23)

friend.prompt: {name} can buy a plant for $10, or for $25 from a neighbor raising money for the animal shelter. Which?

cards.prompt: Two pairs of sneakers. Both comfy, both built to last, both in budget. The pair you love costs $80 more. You've watched 11 unboxing videos of it.

options.t: Buy them. I've already worn them in my head.
The other pair. Nobody looks at my feet anyway.

cards.mask: looks like a shopping choice; measures paying for the version you love versus the one that does the same job (Sally Q34, T14)

friend.prompt: {name} can afford either pair of sneakers. The favorite pair costs $80 more. Which one?

b.t: The cheaper pair that does the same job.

cards.prompt: Your group of four runs a weekend pop-up and makes $400. Same hours each. Kai's glitter phone charms sold most of it.
cards.teenPrompt: Your group of four runs a bake sale table and makes $120. Same hours each. Kai's brownies sold most of it.

options.t: Bigger cut for Kai. Talent gets paid.
Four equal piles. Kai gets bragging rights.
Equal piles, then I slip Kai $20 of mine. Shh.
Put it to a vote. Majority wins, even if I sulk.
Skip the split. Team dinner, all of it.

cards.mask: looks like splitting cash; measures crediting results versus shared effort (Sally Q16, T15, slight T12B), with a fair-process exit (L3)

friend.prompt: {name}'s group of four made $400. Kai's phone charms sold most of it. How does {name} split it?

cards.prompt: If your bank app could talk, which two would it bring up first?

options.t: I have a savings goal with a name.
I've booked something before checking my balance.
I own the fancy version of one boring thing.
I've bragged about a dupe for a full week.
I could tell you what I spent on boba last month.
My fun money is gone by the 10th. Somehow.

cards.mask: looks like a money meme list; measures save versus leap (L1, T13), treat versus trim (T14) and track versus feel (T24), each slight

cards.prompt: A limited banner drops tonight. Your favorite character, 48 hours only. You have $30 of fun money this month.

options.t: Pull. All of it. Tonight.
Wait for the rerun. They always come back.
Skip it. That $30 already has a job.
Watch a friend pull and scream along for free.

cards.mask: looks like gacha FOMO; checks the L1 and T13 read (leap now versus hold), with T24 and T14 as side guesses. Runs in the finale (slot 2 per the flow judge), not in this chapter.
